convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a custom indicator 'DarvasBoxes_System' with non-standard buffer indices (6), and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_)

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade execution timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator

other_exits: Buy positions closed when Col[1]<2 (bearish Darvas box signal) and BuyPosClose input is true
Sell positions closed when Col[1]>2 (bullish Darvas box signal) and SellPosClose input is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lots at MM value, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 is the multiplier or lot size depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer index 6 of the custom DarvasBoxes_System indicator. It copies 2 values starting at SignalBar offset into array Col[]. The signal logic: if Col[1]>2 (current signal bar shows bullish Darvas state) AND Col[0]<3 (previous bar not already in strong bullish state), then buy signal fires. If Col[1]<2 (bearish Darvas state) AND Col[0]>1 (previous bar not already in strong bearish state), then sell signal fires. The Col[0] checks appear to prevent duplicate entries on consecutive bars. SignalBar input (default 1) shifts which bar is evaluated, allowing backtesting alignment. TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles all position open/close with margin mode logic, timing via UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime, and global variable cleanup on deinit.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator DarvasBoxes_System must be reimplemented in Python - its buffer 6 output encoding (values 1-3 for box state) must be reverse-engineered from the indicator source. TradeAlgorithms.mqh money management and execution helpers need replacement: position sizing with 5 margin modes, BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen with signal time tracking, BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with deviation handling, and GlobalVariableDel_ cleanup. The SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips) and may need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers. New bar detection (CIsNewBar) and history loading (LoadHistory) also need Python equivalents. Signal time is computed as last bar datetime + period seconds, used by trade functions for fill timing.
